test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mechi river is a tributary of which river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahananda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mechi River

 
 
• The **Mechi River **is a **transboundary river **flowing through **Nepal and India**.
 
• It is a **tributary **of the **Mahananda River**.
 
• **The Kosi-Mechi **river **interlinking project **has been recently **approved by the center**, providing a major lease of life in the **Seemanchal region **of **Bihar**.
 
• The project is **worth 4900 crores**.
 
• This **project is a green project**.
 
• Its **environmental approval **note states the project involves no displacement of population and there is **no acquisition **of any **forest land**.
 
• This **project **not only relieves north Bihar from the menace of **recurring floods **but **also provides irrigation for over 2.14 lakh hectares**.
 
• It is the **second major river interlinking project **after **Ken-Betwa of MP**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **important tributaries **of **Ganga **are the **Yamuna, the Ramaganga, the Gomti, the Ghagra, the Son, the Gandak, the Burhi Gandak, the Kosi **and the **Mahananda**.
 
• **Teesta **and **Meghna **are the **tributaries **of the **Brahmaputra river **which joins the **basin**.
 
• **Hooghly river **has **two tributaries**: **the Rupnarayan River **and **Damodar River**. Hooghly also **reaches Bay of Bengal **at **Nurpur **and then **empties into the sea**.
